business.description: Ventura Guaranty Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that operates primarily through its subsidiaries. The Company's standalone performance is driven by its NBFC business, while consolidated operations include broking, commodities, and allied services through its subsidiaries.

outlook.statement: The Group continued to focus on strengthening its technology platform, enhancing digital capabilities, improving customer experience and expanding its financing business, including the Margin Trading Facility (MTF), with a view to supporting long-term sustainable growth and operational efficiency.
The management continues to evaluate potential opportunities in line with its investment objectives.

India's growing economy, increasing financial inclusion, digitalisation and continued regulatory reforms present long-term opportunities for the financial services sector. At the same time, geopolitical developments, global trade uncertainties, interest rate movements, inflationary pressures, market volatility and changes in the regulatory landscape may continue to influence the operating environment.
The Board of Directors are evaluating pursuing alternative businesses in the financial services space.

key_audit_matters: Delay in IEPF Transfer: Certain amounts of unclaimed dividends and related shares pertaining to past financial years were not transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) within the stipulated time. Specifically, Rs 0.08 lacs pertaining to FY 2013-14 and Rs 0.32 lacs pertaining to FY 2017-18 were transferred with delay. The Company has recognised an interest liability of Rs 0.39 lacs in the financial statements for FY 2025-26.

Audit Trail Feature: In the Holding Company, the audit trail feature in the accounting software was enabled with effect from October 1, 2024 and has operated effectively thereafter. The Company will take appropriate measures to ensure full compliance with audit trail requirements going forward.

Emphasis of Matter: Scheme of Amalgamation of Kashmira Investment and Leasing Private Limited with the Company approved by NCLT vide order dated November 17, 2025. Comparative financial information restated in accordance with Appendix C of Ind AS 103.

During the year, the company belatedly transferred the unclaimed dividends of Rs 0.22 lacs which ought to have been transferred on 31-10-2025 to the IEPF and not within the stipulated time as required by Section 124 of the Companies Act, 2013, and the IEPF Rules. Furthermore, the company did not transfer unclaimed dividends and related shares to the IEPF within the stipulated time. Specifically, an amount of Rs 0.08 lacs pertaining to FY 2013-14 and an amount of Rs 0.32 lacs pertaining to FY 2017-18 which ought to have been transferred on 04-11-2021 and 19-12-2024 respectively. This delay constitutes a non-compliance with the relevant regulations. The impact of this delay on the financial statements is a liability of interest to be paid and transferred to IEPF which has been duly recognized in the profit and loss account under finance cost.

In respect of loans and advances in the nature of loans granted by the Company, the parties are regular in repayment of interest and loan amount as applicable except in the case of M/s Darvin Consultancy Pvt Ltd. Amount overdue: Rs 194.33 lakhs, Date Due: 28-09-2019, Extent of delay: 2377 days. Management is quite hopeful of recovering the overdue loan amount from the entity.
The Company has not paid/provided for managerial remuneration and thus the provisions of Section 197 read with Schedule V to the Act are not applicable to the company.
